import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pickle
import random
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch

from demosaic.collaborative_detail import collaborative_detail

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def ref(path):
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    return {"path": str(p), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write("\n")


def rng():
    return {"python": hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(random.getstate())).hexdigest(), "numpy": hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(np.random.get_state())).hexdigest(), "torch_CPU": hashlib.sha256(torch.get_rng_state().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest(), "torch_CUDA": hashlib.sha256(torch.cuda.get_rng_state().cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()}


def errors(value, target, roi):
    x, y, w, h = roi
    full = value.astype(np.float64)-target.astype(np.float64)
    crop = full[..., y:y+h, x:x+w]
    dc = crop.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
    return {"full_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(full**2))*65535), "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((crop-dc)**2))*65535), "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2))*65535)}


def main():
    os.nice(10)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    plan_path = ROOT / "transfer-plan-v1.json"
    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    policy = plan["policy"]
    assert ref(policy["module"]["path"]) == policy["module"]
    assert len(plan["observations"]) == 694
    for binding in [*policy["source_refs"], *plan["origin_panels"]]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    out = ROOT / "transfer-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    (out / "rows").mkdir()
    (out / "predictions").mkdir()
    photo_path = ROOT.parent / "V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("photo_metrics", photo_path)
    photo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(photo)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[-1:1:512j, -1:1:512j]
    q = np.linalg.qr(np.stack([np.ones_like(xx), xx, yy], -1).reshape(-1, 3), mode="reduced")[0]

    def detrend(value):
        v = value.reshape(3, -1).T
        return v - q @ (q.T @ v)

    torch.cuda.init()
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(min(.9, 12*2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory))
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    before = rng()
    rows, started = [], time.time()
    for index, case in enumerate(plan["observations"]):
        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available >= 32*2**30
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        assert ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        parent = np.load(case["parent"]["path"])
        delta, diagnostic = collaborative_detail(torch.from_numpy(parent).cuda(), torch.from_numpy(arrays["packed"]).cuda(), torch.from_numpy(arrays["variance"]).cuda(), torch.from_numpy(arrays["colors"]).cuda(), neighbors=policy["neighbors"], alpha=policy["alpha"])
        correction = delta.cpu().numpy()
        corrected = parent + correction
        changed = not np.array_equal(parent, corrected)
        binding = case["parent"]
        if changed:
            path = out / "predictions" / f"{index:03d}.npy"
            np.save(path, corrected)
            binding = ref(path)
        values = {"parent": (parent, case["parent"]), "collaborative": (corrected, binding)}
        if "periodic_detail" in case:
            assert ref(case["periodic_detail"]["path"]) == case["periodic_detail"]
            values["periodic-detail"] = (np.load(case["periodic_detail"]["path"]), case["periodic_detail"])
        if case["kind"] == "mesh":
            empty = arrays["target_empty"][0].astype(np.float64)
            signal = detrend(arrays["target_present"][0].astype(np.float64)-empty)
            energy = np.sum(signal**2)
            blank = np.all(arrays["target_present"] == arrays["target_empty"], axis=1)[0] if case["present"] else np.ones((512, 512), bool)
        actual_rows = []
        for label, (value, prediction) in values.items():
            row = {"id": case["id"], "index": index, "kind": case["kind"], "method": label, "prediction": prediction, "changed": not np.array_equal(value, parent)}
            if label == "collaborative":
                row["diagnostic"] = diagnostic
                row["correction_RMS_DN16"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(correction.astype(np.float64)**2))*65535)
            if case["kind"] == "mesh":
                row.update(present=case["present"], seed=case["seed"], **errors(value, arrays["target"], [176, 176, 160, 160]))
                difference = value[0].astype(np.float64)-parent[0].astype(np.float64)
                row["template_gain"] = float(np.sum(detrend(value[0].astype(np.float64)-empty)*signal)/energy)
                row["blank_pixels"] = int(blank.sum())
                row["blank_added_RMS_DN16"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(difference[:, blank]**2))*65535) if blank.any() else None
                if label == "periodic-detail":
                    assert abs(row["full_error_RMS_DN16"]-case["periodic_expected_full_RMS"]) < 1e-10
            elif case["kind"] == "photo":
                row.update(cohort=case["cohort"], variant=case["variant"]["name"], **photo.photo_metrics(value, arrays["target"], arrays, case["ROI_xywh"]))
            elif case["kind"] == "flat":
                row.update(noise=case["noise"]["name"], **errors(value, arrays["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]))
            else:
                assert case["kind"] == "real"
                row["reference_scored"] = False
            rows.append(row)
            actual_rows.append(row)
        save(out / "rows" / f"{index:03d}.json", {"case_index": index, "rows": actual_rows})
        for key in ("arrays", "parent"):
            assert ref(case[key]["path"]) == case[key]
        if index % 32 == 0:
            print(json.dumps({"finished": index+1, "elapsed_seconds": time.time()-started, "changed": sum(r["changed"] for r in rows if r["method"] == "collaborative")}), flush=True)
        del delta, correction, corrected, parent, arrays, values
    after = rng()
    assert before == after
    assert ref(policy["module"]["path"]) == policy["module"]
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        key = (row["kind"], row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise"))), row.get("cohort"), row["method"])
        groups[key].append(row)
    summary = []
    for (kind, condition, cohort, method), group in groups.items():
        item = {"kind": kind, "condition": condition, "cohort": cohort, "method": method, "cases": len(group), "changed": sum(v["changed"] for v in group)}
        for field in ("full_error_RMS_DN16", "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16", "crop_relative_band_error", "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain", "template_gain", "blank_added_RMS_DN16"):
            selected = [v[field] for v in group if v.get(field) is not None]
            if selected:
                item[field] = float(np.mean(selected))
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_added_RMS_DN16"] = max(v["blank_added_RMS_DN16"] or 0 for v in group)
        summary.append(item)
    result = {"status": "complete-unchanged-policy-cached-transfer", "plan": ref(plan_path), "operator": ref(__file__), "module": policy["module"], "photo_metric_operator": ref(photo_path), "created_unix_UTC": started, "finished_unix_UTC": time.time(), "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}, "rows": rows, "summary": summary, "RNG_before": before, "RNG_after": after, "RNG_unchanged": True, "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(), "new_model_forwards": 0, "new_DINO_forwards": 0, "new_noise_draws": 0, "training_updates": 0, "RAW_decodes": 0, "scope": plan["scope"]}
    save(out / "result-v1.json", result)
    print(json.dumps(summary), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def run(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    Path(plan.get("claim_path", root / "run.claim")).open("x").close()
    state = {
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(path),
        "completed": dict(plan.get("adopted_collections", {})),
    }

    def record(status, **extra):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **extra)
        save(Path(plan.get("status_path", root / "supplement-status.json")), state)

    try:
        for label in ("V143", "V144", "V145"):
            point = root / label
            if label in state["completed"]:
                assert label == "V143"
                retained_parent_collection(root, state["completed"][label])
                record("adopted-parent-collection-without-replay", model=label)
                continue
            if label != "V143":
                record("waiting-for-both-original-primary-reviews", model=label)
                deadline = min(
                    time.time() + 72000, plan.get("absolute_deadline_unix", float("inf"))
                )
                while True:
                    primary = read(
                        Path(plan.get("primary_status_path", PRIMARY / "review-status.json"))
                    )
                    assert primary["owner"] == plan["primary_owner"]
                    assert primary["plan"] == plan["primary_review_plan"]
                    assert not primary["status"].startswith("failed"), primary
                    if primary[
                        "status"
                    ] == "completed-both-pilots-awaiting-native-viewing" and not live(
                        primary["owner"]
                    ):
                        break
                    assert time.time() < deadline
                    time.sleep(10)
                executed = read(PRIMARY / label / "plan-v1.json")
                guard(executed)
                queued = read(point / "queue-plan-v1.json")
                save(
                    point / "plan-v1.json",
                    {
                        **queued,
                        "checkpoint": executed["checkpoint"],
                        "inputs": [
                            *queued["inputs"],
                            executed["checkpoint"],
                            ref(PRIMARY / label / "plan-v1.json"),
                        ],
                    },
                )
            actual = read(point / "plan-v1.json")
            guard(actual)
            record("collecting-declared-photographic-contexts", model=label)
            with (point / "collect.log").open("x") as log:
                subprocess.run(
                    [
                        plan["python"],
                        "-P",
                        actual["collector"]["path"],
                        str(point / "plan-v1.json"),
                    ],
                    cwd=Path(actual["work"]),
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    check=True,
                    timeout=3600,
                    env={
                        **os.environ,
                        "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0",
                        "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1",
                        "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE": "1",
                        "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                        "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                        "PYTHONPATH": f"{actual['work']}/src:{actual['work']}/scripts",
                    },
                )
            state["completed"][label] = ref(point / "collection-v1.json")
            record("completed-photographic-collection", model=label)
        record("completed-photo-collections-making-report")
        report(path)
        record("auditing-photographic-supplement")
        with (root / "independent-audit.log").open("x") as log:
            subprocess.run(
                [plan["python"], "-P", plan["auditor"]["path"], str(path)],
                cwd=REPO,
                env={**os.environ, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": ""},
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                check=True,
                timeout=1800,
            )
        record("completed-photographic-supplement-awaiting-native-viewing")
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-photographic-supplement-preserved", error=repr(error))
        raise


def photo_metrics(value, target, arrays, roi):
    from report_checkpoint_pilot import band

    from demosaic.archive_metrics import linear_rgb

    x, y, w, h = roi
    a, b = [v[..., y : y + h, x : x + w].astype(np.float64) for v in (value, target)]
    error = a - b
    dc = error.mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
    predicted, _ = band(linear_rgb(a, arrays))
    truth, _ = band(linear_rgb(b, arrays))
    energy = float(np.sum(truth * truth))
    if energy <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Photo diagnostic needs nonzero target detail")
    gain = float(np.sum(predicted * truth) / energy)
    return {
        "full_error_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.mean((value.astype(np.float64) - target) ** 2)) * 65535
        ),
        "crop_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain": gain,
        "crop_relative_band_error": float(np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - truth) ** 2) / energy)),
        "crop_orthogonal_band_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - gain * truth) ** 2) / (100 * 256)) * 65535
        ),
    }


def report(path):
    from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels

    from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar

    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    parent = {
        o["id"]: o["parent_prediction"] for o in plan["observations"] if "parent_prediction" in o
    }
    predictions, checkpoints = {}, {}
    for label, count in (("V143", 64), ("V144", 128), ("V145", 128)):
        point = root / label
        actual = read(point / "plan-v1.json")
        guard(actual)
        collection = read(point / "collection-v1.json")
        assert collection["plan"] == ref(point / "plan-v1.json")
        assert collection["counts"] == {"root": count, "encoder": count}
        assert collection["RNG_unchanged"]
        assert collection["full_model_before"] == collection["full_model_after"]
        assert collection["backbone_before"] == collection["backbone_after"]
        bindings = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in collection["observations"]}
        if label == "V143":
            assert not parent.keys() & bindings.keys()
            parent.update(bindings)
            bindings = parent
        predictions[label] = bindings
        checkpoints[label] = actual["checkpoint"]
    assert all(set(p) == {o["id"] for o in plan["observations"]} for p in predictions.values())
    out = root / "report-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    rows, images = [], []
    for observation in plan["observations"]:
        assert ref(observation["arrays"]["path"]) == observation["arrays"]
        with np.load(observation["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as data:
            arrays = {k: data[k] for k in data.files}
        values = {}
        for label, bindings in predictions.items():
            binding = bindings[observation["id"]]
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            values[label] = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "id": observation["id"],
                    "source_id": observation["source"]["id"],
                    "cohort": observation["cohort"],
                    "variant": observation["variant"]["name"],
                    "pattern": observation["pattern"],
                    "method": label,
                    "prediction": binding,
                    **photo_metrics(
                        values[label], arrays["target"], arrays, observation["ROI_xywh"]
                    ),
                }
            )
        if observation["pattern"] != "RGGB":
            continue
        all_values = {"Noisy": noisy_malvar(arrays), **values, "Constructed GT": arrays["target"]}
        roi = observation["ROI_xywh"]
        x, y, w, h = roi
        anchor = (
            arrays["target"][..., y : y + h, x : x + w]
            .astype(np.float64)
            .mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
        )

        def emit(
            labels,
            contrast,
            suffix,
            observation=observation,
            all_values=all_values,
            anchor=anchor,
            arrays=arrays,
            roi=roi,
        ):
            canvas = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(labels), 192), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
            panels = []
            for i, label in enumerate(labels):
                value = anchor + contrast * (all_values[label].astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(value, arrays, roi, observation["display_exposure"])
                assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                x0 = 8 + 168 * i
                canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), (x0, 24))
                draw.text((x0, 5), label, font=font, fill="black")
                panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x0, 24, 160, 160]})
            target = out / (observation["id"] + "-" + suffix + ".png")
            canvas.save(target)
            reread = np.asarray(Image.open(target))
            for panel in panels:
                label = panel["label"]
                value = anchor + contrast * (all_values[label].astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(value, arrays, roi, observation["display_exposure"])
                x0, y0, w0, h0 = panel["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y0 : y0 + h0, x0 : x0 + w0], cell)
            images.append(
                {
                    "image": ref(target),
                    "observation": observation,
                    "panels": panels,
                    "checkpoint_hashes": {k: v["sha256"] for k, v in checkpoints.items()},
                    "shared_display_contrast": contrast,
                    "shared_camera_RGB_anchor": anchor.ravel().tolist(),
                    "display_exposure": observation["display_exposure"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                }
            )

        emit(list(all_values), 1, "comparison")
        if observation["variant"]["name"] == "photo-faint":
            emit(list(all_values), 8, "contrast8-comparison")
        if observation["cohort"] == "organic384" and observation["source"]["id"] in (
            read(root / "organic-source-choice-v1.json")["sources"][0]["id"],
            read(root / "organic-source-choice-v1.json")["sources"][1]["id"],
        ):
            for method in ("V144", "V145"):
                emit(["Noisy", method, "Constructed GT"], 1, method + "-triplet")
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[row["cohort"], row["variant"], row["method"]].append(row)
    keys = [k for k, v in rows[0].items() if isinstance(v, float)]
    summary = [
        {
            "cohort": k[0],
            "variant": k[1],
            "method": k[2],
            "cases": len(v),
            "independent_source_images": len({r["source_id"] for r in v}),
            **{metric: float(np.mean([r[metric] for r in v])) for metric in keys},
        }
        for k, v in groups.items()
    ]
    save(
        out / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-photographic-supplement-report-awaiting-independent-audit-and-viewing",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "images": images,
            "actual_new_root_and_encoder_calls": 320,
            "new_noise_observations": 64,
            "metric_definition": "Camera-RGB error and DC/spatial decomposition; native160 linear-sRGB "
            "luma DCT16 annulus1/8<=frequency<1/3, no content selection. Ideal gain1; gain requires "
            "error/residual checks. Constructed targets are not exact physical scene GT. Per-CFA "
            "cases share16 source images; do not treat128 cases as128 independent photos.",
        },
    )
    print(out / "result-v1.json")
